name: pseudo-excitation method
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 利用等效确定性激励求取随机振动频域响应的方法。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道等系统的线性或线性化随机振动分析中，构造与随机激励谱对应的确定性复谐波虚拟激励，以求取响应功率谱、减少随机样本计算，也可作为频域分析结果的比较基准。

complete_examples.text: Pseudo-excitation method proposed by Lin et al. [35] is a highly efficient algorithm for structural stationary/nonstationary random analysis.
In this part, a pseudo-excitation method (PEM), theoretically applicable for linear systems, is applied to achieve the random analysis of vehicle-track systems.

Besides a systematic framework integrating the train–track dynamic model, track irregularity PSD evolution model and the Pseudo-excitation method is developed to predict the uncertain responses of system components long-termly.

Pseudo-excitation method (PEM) developed by Lin et al. [16] is a highly efficient algorithm for structural stationary/non-stationary random analysis, through the PSD characterisation method can be perfectly applied to evaluate the system dynamic behaviours.
